facts.business: Winro Commercial (India) Limited is a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) registered with the Reserve Bank of India as an Investment and Credit Company (NBFC-ICC), engaged in the business of investment and trading in shares and securities and lending activities.

segments.name: Investment and Trading in Shares and Securities

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital expenditure on property, plant and equipment

key_risks: Classification of investee entities as associates vs subsidiaries involves significant judgement
Pledged quoted equity investments for margin with stock broker and credit facilities from NBFCs
No material subsidiaries but six associate entities requiring consolidation judgement
facts.related_party_note: The Company has not raised any funds through Preferential Allotment/Qualified Institutional Placement. Total fees paid to Statutory Auditors M/s. N.S. Gokhale & Co. during FY 2025-26 on consolidated basis: Rs. 3,97,500 (Statutory audit: Rs. 2,62,500; Limited Review: Rs. 1,05,000; Professional Fees: Rs. 30,000).
